import json,random
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
words=['north','east','south','west']
prefix='Find the final compass direction. Answer with one word.\nFacing north, turn right 90 degrees. Final direction: east\nFacing east, turn left 90 degrees. Final direction: north\n'
cprefix='Copy the starting compass direction. Answer with one word.\nFacing north, turn right 90 degrees. Starting direction: north\nFacing east, turn left 90 degrees. Starting direction: east\n'
for i in range(120):
 d=random.randrange(4); side=random.choice(['right','left']); steps=random.choice([1,2,3]); angle=steps*90
 sentence=f'Facing {words[d]}, turn {side} {angle} degrees. '
 result=words[(d+steps*(1 if side=='right' else -1))%4]
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+sentence+'Final direction:','answer':' '+result})
 control.append({'prompt':cprefix+sentence+'Starting direction:','answer':' '+words[d]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
